title: References
detach: No longer a reference here (the file does not move)

none.song: No reference: a released track to hold this one against. Add one, or mark an audio file of the folder as a reference.
none.artist: No reference for this artist: they will count for all their songs.
none.release: No reference for this release: they will count for all its tracks.

diffHint: How your render differs from the reference, at equal loudness: + it has more, - it has less.
markTip: This is a reference (a released track), not a render of this song: it is never taken for the reference render
marked: "{name}" is a reference of this song
